basics.name: Yaron Lidgi
basics.summary: After a prior professional career, have made a career transition into actuarial science. Passed 3 actuarial exams and expect to soon complete a master’s degree in Applied Statistics. Possess a strong grasp on actuarial methods and, through the use of open-source actuarial Python programming libraries, have gained practical experience applying methods to real and synthetic datasets.

experience.exp_description:
•	Built and validated predictive models using statistical methods and machine learning techniques tailored
to client use cases.
•	Performed data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and model evaluation to ensure accurate and reliable results.

•	Selected to participate in the CAS Student Central Summer Program, an eight-week actuarial professional development program focused on property & casualty insurance fundamentals, ratemaking, reserving concepts, and actuarial career preparation.
